## About
We're a smog check and repair shop on Lemon Grove Way, also known as My Auto Pro. We smog all types of vehicles, including diesels, out of state cars and change of owner checks, and we're a DMV certified brake and light inspection station for salvage and out of state vehicles.
If your car failed its smog check or you're not sure it will pass, bring it in. Our ASE certified mechanics handle the repairs too, from oil changes and tune ups to brakes, air conditioning and cooling systems, on American cars and imports.
We've added auto registration services, so you can often take care of the paperwork in the same visit. Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating from 250 Google reviews.

## Services
- Licensed Star smog check: Smog checks for all types of vehicles, including Star certification, out of state, change of owner and diesel smog checks.
- DMV certified brake and light inspection: The inspection and certificate the DMV requires before a salvage or out of state vehicle can be registered.
- Auto registration services: Help with getting your vehicle registered, right here at the shop.
- Repair for all types of cars: Oil changes, tune ups, brake repair, air conditioning, cooling systems, shocks and struts and used and new tires for American cars and imports.
- Smog inspections and repair: If your vehicle failed a smog check or you're worried it won't pass, we can do the repairs it needs.

## FAQ
Q: Is an appointment necessary?
A: No. You can bring your vehicle by during business hours, Monday through Friday.

Q: Why does my salvage vehicle need a brake and light inspection?
A: The California DMV requires a state-licensed Brake and Lamp Inspection Station to check that brakes and headlamps are safe before a salvaged vehicle is retitled. We do the inspection and issue the certificate you take to the DMV.

Q: Is the smog re-test free?
A: Yes, if we do the repairs, the re-test is free.
